verdict.rationale: A live probe returned HTTP 200 for Linear's llms.txt. The llms.txt itself states that every linear.app page is also available as Markdown, and a second probe confirmed a .md docs page that carries an agent-directed note. Together these give an agent a documented entry point plus machine-readable docs to follow. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents successfully consuming the llms.txt and Markdown docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://linear.app/llms.txt # Linear
Each page on linear.app is also available as Markdown.
For agents: connect to the Linear MCP server at https://mcp.linear.app/mcp to read and change issues, projects
